overall: The AG found the Manomet Village Steering Committee violated G.L. c. 30A, § 18 when the chair forwarded an email with his own opinion to a quorum, an impermissible deliberation outside an open meeting; resolved by informal action with remedial steps and an order to comply.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the chair distributed a private association email to the whole committee on Feb 8, 2012, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when the Chair forwarded an email on February 8, 2012 to a quorum of the Committee and included his own opinion on a matter within the Committee's jurisdiction.

remedy: Acknowledge the violation at an upcoming meeting and publicly disclose the February 8, 2012 email (remedial steps the Chair said the Committee would take, per the May 1, 2012 call).
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: In addition to those remedial steps, we order immediate and future compliance with law.
